results.controlIntent: a. Generate time stamps for audit records using internal system clocks; and b. Record time stamps for audit records that meet [Assignment: organization-defined granularity of time measurement] and that use Coordinated Universal Time, have a fixed local time offset from Coordinated Universal Time, or that include the local time offset as part of the time stamp.

judgment.rationale:
The two CloudTrail audit records retrieved for the churn-predictor-endpoint — a CreateEndpoint event (id: 8f0f7d37-f45a-41d4-9de2-c04b7aef8e90, eventTime: 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z) and an UpdateEndpoint event (id: 7c13f4c6-7535-4b9e-ad09-9611230a8ecc, eventTime: 2026-03-15T14:22:00Z) — both carry ISO 8601 timestamps with the 'Z' (UTC) suffix. This satisfies AU-8.v1(a) (timestamps generated by internal system clocks via AWS CloudTrail) and the UTC requirement of AU-8.v1(b). Granularity is to the second, which is substantive and typical for audit purposes.

However, the assessment is only partially satisfied because: (1) the organization's formally defined granularity requirement (the SP 800-53 'Assignment' parameter) was not available in the retrieved evidence, so it cannot be confirmed that second-level granularity meets the organization's specific threshold; (2) only CloudTrail events were available — there is no evidence about whether the ML platform, model registry, or endpoint runtime generate their own audit logs with conformant timestamps; and (3) the notes embedded in the events flag change-control anomalies (deployment before registry approval, hotfix with no registry entry), suggesting audit completeness may be a broader concern.
gaps: Organization's formally defined granularity requirement (SP 800-53 'Assignment' parameter value) — needed to confirm second-level granularity is sufficient
Audit log configuration for the ML platform, model registry, and endpoint runtime — to confirm all audit-generating components use UTC-aligned internal clocks
Evidence of NTP or time-sync configuration for underlying compute (e.g., SageMaker instance time sync settings)
Human attestation from the security/compliance team confirming the organization's time-stamp policy and its application to this endpoint

payload.note: Deployed 2h BEFORE registry approval at 09:00 — change control not satisfied
Hotfix deploy — no corresponding registry entry found
